ma.getSystemInfo(Object object)

Get system information.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

object.success Callback Function

Parameter

Object res

Attribute Type Description
brand String Device brand.
model String Device model. After a new model is released for a period of time, unknown is displayed. Adaptation will be performed as soon as possible.
id String Device id (new in 24.3.0)
pixelRatio Number Device pixel ratio.
screenWidth Number Screen width, in pixels.
screenHeight Number Screen height, in pixels.
windowWidth Number Available window width, in pixels.
windowHeight Number Available window height, in pixels.
statusBarHeight Number Status bar height, in pixels.
language String System language.
system String Operating system and version.

Sample Code

ma.getSystemInfo({
  success(res) {
    console.log(res.model);
    console.log(res.pixelRatio);
    console.log(res.id);
    console.log(res.windowWidth);
    console.log(res.windowHeight);
    console.log(res.language);
  }
});

Tips

  1. If the device ID cannot be queried, there will be no id field in the return body.
